# Pull Request

Thank you for your interest in contributing.

Pull requests are not accepted during the closed beta. The codebase is in active development and the author is sole maintainer at this stage.

If you have found a bug, please [file a bug report](https://github.com/swiftiansolutions/divergentdecisions-mcp/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).

If you have a suggestion or want to share feedback, please [file a feedback issue](https://github.com/swiftiansolutions/divergentdecisions-mcp/issues/new?template=feedback.md).

Contributions will open in a future phase. Watch the repository for updates.
